text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text:
So, Kitasan Black, you finally arrive! I am
the
extraordinary Magical Girl Sweepy!

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text: And I am the mastermind pulling her str— Ahem. I'm her supporting scientist, Tachyon.

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text:
You told me you want the chance to
help other
people, right? Well, look no
further...

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text:
I'm naming you Magical Black, newest
member of
the Magical Girl ☆ Sweepy 5!

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text:
Yep! You'll have nothing to fear 'cause I,
a future
great witch, am going to teach
you about magic!

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
And I'll be experimenting on y—er, I'd
like to
request your cooperation in
testing "magical
items."

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
Hmm, if I become a magical girl, I'll be
able to
save people who are in trouble,
just like in an
anime, right?

text_block_list.name: Kitasan Black
text_block_list.text:
You've got to let me join! And it'd be
great if Dia
could join, too!

text_block_list.name: Sweep Tosho
text_block_list.text:
"Magical Dia"... That doesn't sound half
bad! ♪
Her name's a good fit—she's in!

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text: Another guinea pi—another member would be splendid. I'm sure my research will benefit greatly.

text_block_list.name: Agnes Tachyon
text_block_list.text:
A serum to dramatically increase muscle
mass or...
a mood-elevating tonic to
make you feel you can
accomplish
anything... Which shall I have you test

first?
